newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanwha in tie-up with Hoechst unit.
newsitem.headline: Hanwha in tie-up with Hoechst unit.

text.p: South Korea's Hanwha Chemical Corp said on Thursday it had formed a technical tie-up with Hoechst AG's U.S. unit Hoechst Celanese Corp to cooperate in the production of a raw material for powdered paint.
Hoechst will provide Hanwha with technology needed for the production of neo-pentyl-glycol, a chemical required in the production of powdered paint, in return for royalties, a Hanwha spokesman said.
But he declined to elaborate on the royalty.
Hanwha will soon begin building a 50 billion won plant, with annual capacity of 20,000 tonnes, in South Korea for commercial production from late 1998, he said.
Around half of the plant's annual output will be sold in overseas markets, he added.
